notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 31-33) does not contain the General Studies: Social and Behavioral Sciences A.A. program section. No blocks were recorded: GE pattern courses never go in a block, and no major requirements for this award are printed in the text.

The LACCD GE page states general rules ('General Education Requirements: Minimum of 27 semester units'; 'Major Requirements: Minimum of 18 units in a single or related field'). These are generic minimums, not this award's totals, so total_units, degree_total and ge_units stay null.
General Studies degrees at LACCD likely use the LACCD GE pattern and draw the area of emphasis from Area 4B, but the text does not state this for the award, so ge_pattern is null.
A reviewer should fetch the actual program page (likely elsewhere in the catalog PDF) to record the area-of-emphasis requirements, outcomes and careers.
